Subject: Post-discovery recap & proposed 30-minute walkthrough (stakeholder time pairs)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a suggested next step to keep momentum:

- Objective we heard: evaluate Redwood for inference serving across dev and pilot environments; focus on latency SLA and private deployment options.
- Key stakeholders: you (product), your infra lead (I believe that's Raj Patel), and the security reviewer.
- Top questions to answer in the next meeting: demo of a 30-min end-to-end flow (integration + cost/latency tradeoffs), and high-level notes on compliance controls (SOC2 evidence path).

To make scheduling simpler, I put together three compact time pairs that let your product + infra/security stakeholders attend without blocking full afternoons. Each bracket is a 30-minute intro with a short pre-read attached. Please pick the best for your team or suggest alternatives:

1) Tue Jun 10 — 10:00–10:30am PT (Product + Infra)
2) Wed Jun 11 — 2:00–2:30pm PT (Product + Security)
3) Thu Jun 12 — 11:30am–12:00pm PT (Product + Infra backup)

Attachment: redwood-demo-outline.pdf — 1-page agenda + prep asks.

If none of those work, tell me the day windows that do and I’ll compress options into three concise choices for Raj/security.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick notes from our side: Raj (infra) is available on Tue morning and Thu midday; our security reviewer (security@pilgrimhealth.com) prefers afternoons after 1pm.
